Applying for 2027 entry

Choose your subject area below to see how and when to apply. Deadlines depend on the subject, so please check the date for the course you want before you start.

Application deadlines

  • Medicine: apply by 15 October 2026
  • Law: apply by 15 January 2027
  • Engineering: apply by 29 January 2027
  • Arts and design: apply by 1 March 2027
  • Music: apply by 1 October 2026 (audition required)
  • Late applications: until 30 June 2027

How to apply

  1. Step 1: create an account
  2. Step 2: upload your documents
  3. Step 3: pay the application fee of 75 EUR
